'''Ymir Flesh''' is a crafting material that can only be purchased from the trader [[Haldor]] after [[The Elder]], the second [[Bosses|boss]], has been defeated. It is used to craft two weapons.

== Availability ==
* Sold from [[Haldor]] for {{Item link|Coins|120}} after [[The Elder]] has been defeated

== Usage ==
=== Crafting ===
*{{Item link|Frostner|size=40px}}
*{{Item link|Iron Sledge|size=40px}}

A total of 23 Ymir Flesh is needed to craft and upgrade both weapons to quality 4.

== Trivia ==
* In the ''Poetic Edda,'' the body of the primeval being Ymir is used to create the world. Ymir's flesh, in particular, is used to create the earth. Therefore, it is possible that this is a pile of ordinary dirt.
* Prior to Patch 0.213.4, it was for sale only after [[Bonemass]], the third boss, has been defeated.

'''Wisp Fountains''' are [[Player base|base]] structures used for collecting [[Wisp]]s, which will be attracted to the fountain when it is dark; either when it is night, or raining, in any biome. Torches and other artificial light sources do not prevent it from summoning wisps.  

They require a [[Stonecutter]] to be built.

== Notes ==
Wisps begin to appear around 18:00. They also appear when it is raining.

A new wisp will join the fountain every 30 seconds, with initially up to three wisps present at a time. Eventually, up to nine wisps can be present near morning.

Hovering over the fountain whilst it is dark enough to attract wisps, it will say, "The wisps are coming." Once the fountain has three wisps, the text will change to "The wisps are dancing." This seems to indicate the fountain has the maximum number of wisps circling it, but it is possible to have more, seemingly due to a bug or quirk in the way the wisp spawning works.

If the player has more than one fountain nearby, the maximum number of wisps is shared among them. Spread the fountains out by more than 20 meters to allow each to reach its maximum.

If they are not caught before the day comes, wisps will fly away and disappear. During the day, while hovering over the fountain, it will say, "The wisps demand darkness."

== Tips ==
* Wisps can also appear during the day if rainy or stormy weather conditions are active. Some players have observed that weather effects triggered by certain boss encounters (such as Eikthyr’s storm) can temporarily allow wisps to spawn even outside normal nighttime conditions, as long as the player remains within the affected area.

* Keeping strong wind active through weather events can also be useful for nearby wind-powered structures, such as windmills, allowing both wisp farming and production benefits at the same time.

* Because wisps will despawn once daylight returns and darkness conditions are no longer met, staying close to the source of the weather effect is required to maintain their appearance.

* In addition to nighttime, some biomes such as the Swamp provide permanent low-light environments, provided the area remains loaded by nearby players.


== Trivia ==
* The description of the Wisp Fountain is a reference to the Aliens movie. The character Newt says the line.

6000 (gates) | tool tier = 5 |resources = * [[Loot chest#Charred Fortress Charred Chests|Charred chest]] * [[Bell Fragment]] * [[Molten Core]] | resistances = pickaxe only | number = 20 }} '''Charred Fortresses''' are [[Points of interest]] in [[Ashlands]]. They are marked by a beam of green light shooting straight up into the sky, visible from a distance. == Location == Each world has 20 Charred Fortresses. They are always located away from the coasts between the inland lava fields, usually inside the central islands of the Ashlands. == Layout == The fortress consists of a tall, rectangular outer wall with many pillars and spiked bronze defenses. Two opposing outer walls have closed gates in them, leading to the interior area. The interior contains an expanse of ground littered with gravestones, with two [[Effigy of Malice|Effigies of Malice]] in the corners and two stone ramps leading up to the parapets atop the exterior walls. In the very center of the fortress interior is a tall tower, capped with more spiked defenses, which has one gate leading inside. The walls (of the exterior and of the interior tower), the pillars, gates and spiked defenses can all be destroyed, but only by [[Damage#Pickaxe|Pickaxe damage of tool tier 5 or higher]] - i.e. a [[Battering Ram]] or a [[Catapult]] with [[Explosive Payload]]s. The pillars have negligible (1) health but the walls (1500), spikes (1500) and especially the gates (6000) have much higher health. The exterior walls are three layers thick, whereas the interior tower walls are only one layer thick. The fortress initially spawns some creatures, independently to the Effigies of Malice, they do not respawn if killed: * Up to 3 [[Charred Warlock]]s (100% chance for the one on top of the tower and 60% chance to spawn for the other). * Up to 5 [[Charred Marksman|Charred Marksmen]] (100% chance for the one on top of the tower and 60% chance to spawn for the other). * Up to 4 [[Skugg]]s (80% chance for each corner of the fortress to have one). == Loot == Inside the central tower can be found: * A Bell Altar, drops 2 to 4 {{Item link|Bell Fragment}}s when destroyed. * A [[Loot chest#Charred Fortress Charred Chests|Charred chest]]. * A [[Vegvisir|Fader Vegvisir]] with a 50% chance to spawn. * 2 [[Molten Core]]s. Other places inside the Fortress: * The interior court can have up to 8 [[Molten Core]]s, with a 5% chance each to spawn. * Up to 3 Charred chests can spawn along the solid walls of the tower (clockwise from the tower entrance: 100%, 13% and 50% chances to spawn). * [[Skugg]] drop {{item link|Charred Cogwheel}}s which allow the player to make a [[Catapult]]. * The bronze spike strips can be destroyed to drop 2-5 [[Scrap Bronze]] each. As each Charred Fortress contains exactly 78 spike strips, one fortress will yield an average of 273 scrap bronze. The content of Charred Chests is: {{Chest|Charred Chest}} == Notes == * The exterior walls (3 layers x 1500 health = 4500 total) are easier to break through than the gates (6000 health). The tower walls (1500 health) are easier still, but be careful not to accidentally destroy any loot (see below). * The Charred chests and the Bell fragment altar are destroyable; while the chests have 200 health and are resistant to most types of damage (except for [[Damage#Lightning|Lightning]], [[Damage#Poison|Poison]] and [[Damage#Spirit|Spirit]]), the altar is extremely fragile - having only 10 health and no damage resistances. * The presence of the Bell fragment altar is indicated by a huge vertical beacon of light, which can be seen at a distance. This beacon can help identify the location of intact fortresses from afar. ** Destroying the altar also removes the beacon. * The eastern and western smaller islands usually generate with no fortress, thus it is best to first land directly south of spawn. * Some segments of the walls can be mined with any pickaxe. This might be due to a bug. == Tips == * A simple strategy to conquer Charred Fortresses is to first master one Charred Fortress, obtain a [[Bloodstone]], and then craft the [[Trollstav]]. Now, the player can easily approach a Charred Fortress and summon [[Summoned Troll]]s from the outside, which will handle the fortress without any issues. Finally, kill the Troll and enjoy the loot! * It is easier to build a wooden ladder to get on top of the wall rather than using a [[Battering Ram]] to destroy the gates/walls. And, if you are lucky with the world generation, you could use one of the naturally spawning giant rocks to get inside too. Once on top of the walls, simply run circles in the walls and slowly kill enemies and destroy the [[Effigy of Malice|spawners]], if you get overwhelmed just jump off outside (be careful if there is lava). * You can destroy the [[Skugg|skuggs]] from outside the fortress with the bow/crossbow or magic, and from a high enough place you can also destroy the [[Effigy of Malice|spawners]] too. * If you conquered the fortress and didn´t destroy the walls/gates to get inside, the fortress is now a perfect place to build a mini base, thanks to the indestructible walls. Only the flying [[Fallen Valkyrie|valkyries]] and [[Volture|Voltures]] can get inside. * There are two ways to get inside the central tower without a [[Battering Ram]]. First is to make a hole on the ground with a pickaxe and simply pass below the wall of the tower (this may not work if you hit the limit on how low the ground can go). Second is to get on top of the tower and get inside through the hole between the spikes, to get out you will need to either portal out or build yourself ladders/platforms to pass through the hole between the spikes again. == Gallery == Charred fortress tower interior.png|The inside of a Charred Fortress tower. At front are two Molten cores; at back are the Bell fragment altar and a Charred chest. The Vegvisir would be at the back left, if it were present. '''Frigid Kiln''' is a structure used to produce {{Item link|Liquid Frost}} out of {{Item link|Ice}}. Liquid Frost is the fuel of the [[Frost Foundry]].

==Availability==
* {{Item link|Frostcore}} can be obtained from [[Winding Tunnels]].
* {{Item link|Ice}} can be obtained by mining [[Ice Sheet]]s on the shore of the [[Deep North]], or dropped from [[Greydwarf (Deep North)|Greydwarfs]] in the Deep North

==Building==
The Frigid Kiln is found in the Crafting category of the [[Hammer]] and requires a nearby [[Workbench]] to build. It cannot be placed on wood, in water or on sloped surfaces. It costs:
* {{Item link|Stone|20}}
* {{Item link|Frostcore|10}}
* {{Item link|Ice|5}}

It has 1,500 durability. It is resistant to blunt, pierce, slash and chop damage, and immune to fire, frost, poison and spirit damage.

==Usage==
Ice is the kiln's only input; it is added like fuel, and no other item is needed. The kiln holds up to 25 [[Ice]] at a time. It produces one [[Liquid Frost]] every 30 seconds by consuming five Ice, so a full load of 25 Ice becomes five Liquid Frost in 150 seconds. Each Liquid Frost is ejected as soon as it is made.

Like the [[Smelter]], the Frigid Kiln stops working while its smoke is blocked.
